title: Sarmentol H derived from Sedum sarmentosum Bunge directly targets FXR to mitigate cholestasis by recruiting SRC-1.
authors: Liu, Zhenxiu; Chen, Lin; Chen, Mingyun; Linghu, Lang; Liao, Zhihua; Chen, Min; Wang, Guowei
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物Sarmentol H靶向核受体FXR缓解胆汁淤积，涉及分子对接与点突变分析配体-蛋白结合，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法仅含对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Farnesoid X receptor (FXR) is a vital receptor for bile acids and plays an important role in the treatment of cholestatic liver disease. In addition to traditional bile acid-based steroidal agonists, synthetic alkaloids are the most commonly reported non-steroidal FXR agonists. Sarmentol H is a nor-sesquiterpenoid obtained from Sedum sarmentosum Bunge, and in vitro screening experiments have shown that it might be related to the regulation of the FXR pathway in a previous study. PURPOSE: To investigate the therapeutic effects of sarmentol H on cholestasis and to determine whether sarmentol H directly targets FXR to mitigate cholestasis. Furthermore, this study aimed to explore the key amino acid residues involved in the binding of sarmentol H to FXR through site-directed mutagenesis. METHODS: An intrahepatic cholestasis mouse model was established to investigate the therapeutic effects of sarmentol H on cholestasis. In vitro experiments, including Co-Ip and FXR-EcRE-Luc assays, were performed to assess whether sarmentol H activates FXR by recruiting the receptor coactivator SRC1. CETSA, SIP, DARTS, and ITC were used to determine the binding of sarmentol H to FXR protein. The key amino acid residues for sarmentol H binding to FXR were analyzed by molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis. Finally, we conducted in vivo experiments on wild-type and Fxr(-/-) mice to further validate the anticholestatic target of sarmentol H. RESULTS: Sarmentol H had significant ameliorative effects on the pathological conditions of cholestatic mice induced with ANIT. In vitro experiments suggested that it is capable of activating FXR and regulating downstream signaling pathways by recruiting SRC1. The target validation experiments showed that sarmentol H had the ability to bind to FXR as a ligand (K(D) = 2.55 mumol/L) and enhance the stability of its spatial structure. Moreover, site-directed mutagenesis revealed that THR292 and TYR365 were key binding sites for sarmentol H and FXR. Furthermore, knockout of the Fxr gene resulted in a significantly higher degree of ANIT-induced cholestatic liver injury than that in wild-type cholestatic mice, and the amelioration of cholestasis or regulatory effects on FXR downstream genes by sarmentol H also disappeared in Fxr(-/-) cholestatic mice. CONCLUSION: Sarmentol H is an FXR agonist. This is the first study to show that it exerts a significant therapeutic effect on cholestatic mice, and can directly bind to FXR and activate it by recruiting the coactivator SRC1.
abstract_zh: 背景：法尼醇X受体（FXR）是胆汁酸的重要受体，在胆汁淤积性肝病的治疗中发挥关键作用。除传统的基于胆汁酸的甾体类激动剂外，合成生物碱是最常报道的非甾体类FXR激动剂。Sarmentol H是从垂盆草（Sedum sarmentosum Bunge）中获得的降倍半萜类化合物，先前研究的体外筛选实验表明其可能与FXR通路的调控有关。目的：研究sarmentol H对胆汁淤积的治疗作用，并确定sarmentol H是否直接靶向FXR以缓解胆汁淤积。此外，本研究旨在通过定点突变探索参与sarmentol H与FXR结合的关键氨基酸残基。方法：建立肝内胆汁淤积小鼠模型，以研究sarmentol H对胆汁淤积的治疗效果。进行体外实验，包括Co-Ip和FXR-EcRE-Luc检测，以评估sarmentol H是否通过招募受体共激活因子SRC1来激活FXR。使用CETSA、SIP、DARTS和ITC确定sarmentol H与FXR蛋白的结合。通过分子对接和定点突变分析sarmentol H与FXR结合的关键氨基酸残基。最后，我们在野生型和Fxr(-/-)小鼠上进行了体内实验，以进一步验证sarmentol H的抗胆汁淤积靶点。结果：Sarmentol H对ANIT诱导的胆汁淤积小鼠的病理状况具有显著的改善作用。体外实验表明，它能够激活FXR并通过招募SRC1调控下游信号通路。靶点验证实验显示，sarmentol H具有作为配体结合FXR的能力（K(D) = 2.55 μmol/L），并增强其空间结构的稳定性。此外，定点突变揭示THR292和TYR365是sarmentol H与FXR结合的关键位点。进一步地，敲除Fxr基因导致ANIT诱导的胆汁淤积性肝损伤程度显著高于野生型胆汁淤积小鼠，且sarmentol H对胆汁淤积的改善作用或对FXR下游基因的调控效应在Fxr(-/-)胆汁淤积小鼠中也消失。结论：Sarmentol H是一种FXR激动剂。这是首次研究表明它对胆汁淤积小鼠具有显著的治疗作用，并能直接结合FXR，通过招募共激活因子SRC1来激活它。
